structure: Texas Administrative Code Ch. 113 Subchapter C (High School). §113.30 implementation note, then one section per course: §113.31 Economics with Emphasis on the Free Enterprise System and Its Benefits, §113.41 United States History Studies Since 1877, §113.42 World History Studies, §113.43 World Geography Studies, §113.44 United States Government, §113.45 Psychology, §113.46 Sociology, §113.47 Special Topics in Social Studies, §113.48 Social Studies Research Methods, §113.49 Personal Financial Literacy, §113.50 Ethnic Studies: Mexican American Studies, §113.51 Ethnic Studies: African American Studies, §113.60 Social Studies Advanced Studies, §113.61 Economics Advanced Studies, §113.76 Personal Financial Literacy and Economics. Each section: title line (course, credit, adoption), (a) Implementation and/or General requirements (credit, recommended grade), Introduction (lettered (b) or (c); numbered paragraphs), Knowledge and skills (lettered (c) or (d); numbered TEKS (1).. with strand/topic name and 'The student is expected to:' sub-items (A), (B)...), then Statutory Authority / Source notes. Course = course title as written without the section number, credit and adoption parentheticals. No grade level is tied to any course, so all content is 9-12.

issues: All course sections are labeled grades 9-12 (some courses state a recommended grade, e.g. §113.31 recommended Grade 12, §113.49 and §113.50-113.51 recommended Grades 10-12, §113.76 recommended Grades 11-12; not treated as binding).
Introduction paragraphs (including mandate-like paragraphs such as Celebrate Freedom Week (A)/(B)) labeled examples per state guide; they could arguably be backup.
u154-u156 (§113.41): the '(A)' label u155 is separated from its text u154 (order swapped in extraction); similar split/swapped sub-item labels at u707-u708, u773-u775 (§113.44).
Several §113.4x-113.5x sentences split across page breaks into adjacent units (e.g. u1091-u1096, u1165-u1170, u1589-u1594, u1271-u1276); same label applies.
u1509, u1543-u1548 (§113.60, §113.61): the '(b) Introduction.' text is inline in the same unit; labeled examples. These two sections' TEKS have no strand names.
Statutory Authority and Source notes (u1262-u1263, u1349-u1350, u1505-u1506, u1539-u1540, u1574-u1575) labeled backup.
